preparacion.fondo: Light, even background with nothing behind the product.
preparacion.luz: Even lighting, no hard shadows on one side.
preparacion.centrado: The product centred and fully inside the frame.
preparacion.distancia: The phone at the same distance for every shot.

permisos.camara_negada: Without camera permission there is nothing to capture. Grant it in your browser settings and come back.
permisos.camara_no_disponible: This browser gives no camera access. The assistant needs a phone and a secure connection (HTTPS).
permisos.sin_nivel: No level: this device does not report tilt, or permission was denied. You can still capture, using the grid as your guide.

nivel.fijando_referencia: This shot sets the reference tilt for the whole set.
nivel.gira_izquierda: Turn the phone {{grados}}° to the left.
nivel.gira_derecha: Turn the phone {{grados}}° to the right.

obturador_bloqueado: The shutter unlocks when the phone returns to the tilt of the first shot.
set_completo: All {{total}} shots are done. Processing and upload come in the next step of the assistant.
error_captura: The photo could not be taken. Try again.

recuperacion.hay_una: There is an unfinished capture for this product, of {{total}} frames. The shots are saved on this device.
recuperacion.continuar: Pick up where you left off

sin_respaldo_local: The shots could not be saved on this device. Capture continues, but closing the tab will lose them.

revision.ayuda: Drag to spin. This is where a crooked frame shows up: if something looks off, capture the set again before publishing it.

publicado: Set published. The product page now shows the 360 viewer.
error_subida: The set could not be uploaded. The shots are still saved on this device: try again.
error_publicar: The set could not be published. The product may already have one published: delete that one first.

error_proceso.IMAGEN_INVALIDA: One of the shots could not be read. Capture the set again.
error_proceso.FONDO_NO_UNIFORME: The background is uneven in one of the shots: there are shadows or something behind the product. Capture again with a light, even background.
error_proceso.SIN_PRODUCTO: In one of the shots the product cannot be told apart from the background. Try a background of a different tone.
error_proceso.PRODUCTO_CORTADO: In one of the shots the product touches the edge of the frame. Step back a little and capture the set again.
error_proceso.SIN_ENCUADRE: The common framing of the set could not be computed. Capture again.
